summary: Per account/host/session Durable Object stores an immutable identity binding and accepted Pi event records keyed by host generation, Pi session, stream and sequence. Duplicate identical events are idempotently acknowledged; conflicting duplicates are rejected. Event pages use increasing row IDs and bounded limits.
lifetime: Durable SQLite history per account-private session; no deletion/retention expiry is defined in this implementation. Host generation is retained as part of event identity.
